uwelhuhk khilo inake'i hi'a nikweha etsatvnhvihstahsi yhowa ulohihstiy tunvnhv titsitsinohihsta
tsani tatawohske inake'i ale alihtsitohvhske khanohehske titawehsti kehsv kanetliyvhstiyi otanvhthv ukvwalhi nahski kayvtthinetiyi ahskanvtsvi

nikatvnho katuhv anehi unatalhihsahe kalohihstiyi
snalenho ahsi kohitiyu kvwakitsti kehsv utitvhe unukotse'i ale inake wulohse'i ale nanha utatolihsthane'i
sawaninho ale nahski anehi kvwhstawatvhse'i
hi'ano ntuwehseli tihso'i totikatuhv witilohi nanha nahskwo kalitsitonhitolvha nahskiyhenho iyuhsti akiluhtsilhv
altsitonhitohenho tsunilawi'ihstiy nikvnathv kelili ale anihskina tekanukowhihske'i
unetskwonho khilakwo iyvtv atayehski utlvkv ulihtthane'i ale utanvkalvtv kehse'i
thalinenho ilvhski winuhsvlhv kekwani wuyvlhe'i tunotsalhohthsenho kaltsote aya'vi
khilakwono iyvtv unitsathi tunilawitsolhe'i nahski iyuhsti vlha yutlnvte vlha nahskwo kalohihstiyulhohti khanhetvnho tultsitonhele'i
kvwaluhtshelenho khilo iyuhsti ulvtalvhski aninhehe'i nahski nvhki iyanitv kvwhanholhe'i
uninulvnhvnho katok na'v uniluhihstiyi aninenulhv iyuhsti unvnehse nanha aya'vi unvnehsvnho elati nunvnele atsehsto nanha ultalvhski kanvhkvi
khilakwono iyvtv tsihsa tsutantv utolehohs nuhstv anatanthehskv totsunatanthvi hi'a nituwehsele'i katonho nahski hi'a ni'uhsti itsatantheha totitsatanvhthvi
kvyohseha thalehvka ale hinaki tsatsehsto ale titsenvhsv whilohi
khilakwono iyvt tulenhe'i unehsvnho atsehsto unukotse nikatv anikathahvi nahski iyuhsti nikatv unihskwanikohse'i ale unelhanvhi unilvkwohthane hi'a nuniwehse'i vlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti yokikoho'i
thalinenho unukotse vtali ulhohti uwetole'i al nikatv unitsathi wkvwaluhtsele'i ale nahski tuweyhonhe'i

tsihsanho nahski uthvkanv hi'a ntuwehsele'i nahski nitunitlvkvna vlha utulhvhti yinunalhstanheho titanhvwihski tsunitlvkihskini vlha unatanvhthi yititsiyanvhilhv anihskanahskini tunatanthv tsunintliyvhstiyi
tsihsan hi'a nituwehsele'i tsiko tkktsvhstihskv anikhahthahi yeli amalhi yanvna atehsvhvhski unelatitohv ikohitv ikohitv atehsvhvhski unelatitohv vlha yeli amalhi yvkvnvna
anikwalihsinho hi'a nikvwawehsele'i kvnhiyukwo katonho unatotakwahskv ika nituyukhohthvna kehsv nanatvneha

kvwahstawatitohin hi'a nikvwawehsele'i tekhikowhahthiha unitsathi ketsanenulahstihskv tsikonho kako akwhsvnka ihatiha
kvwhahthuwhitvnho ukthenole ukowathvhtiyi nahski hi'a iyutvnelvhi
nahskinho akeyv ahska'ihe ale uwenawihske'i akhahthahe nulhstanhelvi uluhtse ale elati utanvnele'i ale nikatv tuyukhohtv unonhele'i

uthvkankwonho tsihsa nuhstv uniwonihsvi hi'a nuwehsele nukvwiyuhsateki tikalawi'ihstiyi lhehsti yihska'ihehsti tsohiyuhsehstikwo

ale nanha vtlha kohuhsti uhskwanikohti tikvwlwhstanti yikehse'i uwahsvhskininhonv ilhski iyanitv tsunitlvk tuhsithatv ale tunwanvi

utantokihinho hawini uliyethane'i ale hi'a nuwehse'i katonho kohi hi'a tsaneha uyelhvhtv uniyhoha utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwehseha vlha khvnikehsv ikekvnheti yikehsehsti uyelhvhtv hi'a khohi tsaneha

hihski katu takikvhaluyv hihski iykayli tetsinelv ilako iyakhali'i thalutsa ulkvhaluyhi itsuthehse'i thalatu ikvwohsele'i

tikhewhinho uwyhanehsv katuhv unukowhse'i tiktholinho tulitsihskwv ale tuhsihthatv kohuhstihsko hikowhahtthiha uwohsele'i

nahskino hi'a khvnikehsv nuwehse'i kwitano uyanvhv ulenvhe ukvhskolvne'i
wtuynhvnho yvwi ale nahskwo kvwahstawatitohi hi'a nituwehsele'i khilo utulihskehsti akhstawatvhstiyi uwahsv atatayhihehsti ale uwahsv utseli tsutanhawtv ayihskehsti ale akhstawatekehsti
khiloyhenho utulihskehsti kvnhv uhstelhvhtiyi nahski uyohuhsehehsti khilohskini kvnhv uyohuhsehehsti ayv ale ohstv khnohetv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti nahski atsihstelhvhti kehsehsti
katoyhenho yunhehkwotsi yvwi iyunho nikvnathv elohi utseli yinulhsthanv uwahsvnho utanvhto yuyohuhselv
ale kato yahvka yvwi yikanetliyvhsta utanhvhto

khiloyhenho akwatehohskehsti ayv ale ayv tsinekvi utahsuyv anhi tinatayhonehi ale anihskana anehvi nahski nahskwo yvwi uwetsi utehohihsti kehsehsti kaluhtsha unhuwohstehsti kalvkwtiyu kehsv utota utselika anehehsti ketsilvkwoti tinikhanhwatitohi
sutalnho wnuhsvlhv tsihsa tuthinhse kwita ale tsimi ale tsani innho ikathi otalv tunhalhuhthane iyvtv unvhsv kehsvi ale utanetliyvhse anikhathhvi
tsunhuwonho tuthalukihske'i utsathi tsunekiyu kehse'i vntsi tsinunekiyv nahskiya'i nahski vlha khilo tikkilohski anhi elohi ehi nahski itsunekv yinitokakvka
khvnikehsvnho nikvwantvnhele ilaya ale mohsi tsihsanho kvwlhinohehtihske'i
kwitanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsele tsihsa thateyhohvhski ohsiyu ani tsitetoha ale tso'i wtotsilhihtsothvka sakwo nihi tsatselika sakwonho mohsi utselika sakwonho ilaya utselika
vlhaynho yakahthahe iyuwehstiyi utsathiyhenho anihska'ihe'i
ulokilnho unulhvthane'i khnekvnho ulokilv tsunanukotse'i hi'a nikawehske'i hi'a nahski tsikeyu'i akwetsi nahski etsathvtahstahsi
tsunikhso'ahsitihsvnho otalvi tunetsele nahski khilo uninhonhehtiyi nikehsvna nuhstv unikohvi khvnhi yvwi uwetsi uyohuhsv tsulehihsanhvhi kehsehsti tuwohsele'i
nahskinho nuwehsv unakhsayhsthane'i tanatathvtvhvhske katkv ayohuhsv tilhihsohti kehsvi
kvwahthvtvnhen hi'a nuniwehse'i katonho tinwelihski ilaya ikvyi takaluhtsi tsanatihsko'i

unetsvnho hi'a nituwehsele'i ilaya utohiyuhi ikvyi uluhihsti ale nikatv uwolhihsohti ale nahskwo hi'a nikvnhvkowhela yvwi uwetsi atsinohehskvi nahski utsathi tsutalenhvtv uklhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti ale ahsekwo taytsiyelvni
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha ilaya utohiyuhi uluhtsv ale nuhstv unatulihskv nikvwanelv nahski'ya nikvn kowhelv nahski atsinohehskvi
kvwhstawatitohinho anetohv uluhtsv unitsathi tukohe kvwantalhuwhste'i al tinhowhelihski kvwanathvtvhelhvihske'i
tuttvnhenho tinowhelihski kato tetsathvtvhelhvhska tuwohsele'i
unetselvn hi'a nuwehse'i yo nitsohiyuhsvna khohi tsitseha ilako ikohitv itsvyelatitohehsti ilako ikohitv unelaki itsvylihsehehsti an hiyathinhoka
unathinhohelenho ukohvnho khilakwo iyvtv atanvhto ukilhvnhe'i elatinho unvtse'i ale tahawo'ihv alitihsvnhihe'i
uttvnhenho utota ilako nikohiki nahski hi'a ikvwalhstanhelvhi uwohsele'i ayolhikwo kehsvi utvnhe'i
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i iyunho ketsohiyti kehsehsti nikatiyu kohuhsti ikyekatvnhehti kohiyuhvhski
kilakwonho iyvtv ayolhi utota uwelhunhe'i ale tikvkhsawo'ihi hi'a nuwehse'i tsakvwiyuhi ko'iyuhvhska skihstelvhsi nakwohiyuhsvna kehsvi
tsihsanho ukohv nahski unitsathi ananelukihskv anatalhihsihskvi uhskatse kataha atanvhto hi'a nuwehsele'i tsvkhewa ale titsali'ena atanto kvnetsheha ehinuko'i ale lhehsti nhakwo ilvhiyu tsihiyvlhi
atantonho uwelhunhv ale utsathi ukilhvnhv unukotse'i ale uyohuhsvhikwo nahskiya kehse'i nahski iyuhsti unitsathe ayohuhi anatihske'i
kaltsotenho wi'uyvlhv kvwahstawatitohi unvhsv kehsv kvwattvnhe'i katonho ayv vlha kayotsinukowhihsti yikehse'i unatvnhe'i
hi'anho nituwehseli hi'a nahski iyuhsti vlha yvkyekanukowha khvnhi atatolihsthanvhi ale amalhi kvnhvhi tsikehso'i
unanhikihsvnho nanhani kelili ayelhi unilohse'i vlhanho yutulihske khilo utolehohihstiy
tuweyhonheynho kvwahstawtitohi ale hi'a nituwehsele'i yvwi uwetsi tatsiyohi teketsiyohihsi yvwi ale takvwli ale onhi nhakwo atsilvhi kehsehsti totvalehihsanhi tso'ine ika
ahsenho vlha yunolihtse nahski nuwehsv ale anihska'ihe unathvtvhtiy
ahsenho elhaweyikwo unvhse'i tina'ihsvhnho aninhehske unvhsv kehsv nahski utli atsilvkwotiyu kehsvi
ayolhinho wuyhanhv aninv ayelhi uwekhanhe'i unhullvn hi'a nituwehsele'i
khiloyhenho nahski nikatlutihskvna tsikehso nahski ikalikonhi kehso'i
nnhnho tulenhv tsutiyi kata ahvi uluhtse'i tsotani ahsknititlv tsulohihsthane'i ale unitsathi yvwi thaline ikvwatalhihsanele'i ale iyutvnhehti kehsv nutvnele'i thaline tuweyhonhe'i
anikwalihsinho kvwaluhtshelv kvwahthvtvnhe'i hi'a nuniwehse'i tuyukohtihsko ahskaya uta'invtiyi utali'i kvwakoliyehske'i
hi'anho nuniwehse'i mohsi ulhskolvhthane kowhelotiyi tokalenvhvi ale ata'invtiyi
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i thstayiyu kehsv iyuhsti titsinawhi hi'a nahski tikhanhwatvhsti itsowlanele'i
titalenihskvhskini uwelhvnhvnvi unelhanvhi ahskaya ale akeyhv tuwolhvnhe'i
nahski iyuhsti ahskaya tekvhtekehsti utota ale utsi ale utali'i atlawhstihskehsti
nahskinho anithal sakwokwo kehsehsti unikwetalhvi nahskinho vlha nhakwo anithali yiki sakwokwohskini unikwetalhvi
nahski iyuhsti unelhanvhi tsuwutahthanvhi lehsti yvwi tsukalenvhthanvki
kalitsotenho aniya'v kvwhstawatitohi thaline ikvwahthvtvnhe nahski ukvwalhi
hi'ano nituwehseli khilo utali'i ata'ekehsti ale nvwatale atayekehsti nahski atayhonehehsti ahskanhvtsehehsti nahski
iyu ale akeyv uyhehi ata'ekehsti ale nwatale tanatsekehsti nahski atayhonehehsti
tsunhstinho tiniyolhi tkvwathinohele'i nahski tsuhsvnhstiyi kvwahstawatitohinho tunikvhskolvne nahski tsunahthinholhvhi
utohiyhiy hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho khilo unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nitatanilvkvna ikehsehsti nahskiya ayolhi tsitatanilvko'i vlha nanha ywvkvyvha
tunehsvnho ale tuhsihthatv ohstv tunhetsele'i
unikihsvnho kanvnhv wluhtsv khilo iyuhsti uttlho'elvki ale tulhinikwanvnelvki uthvtvnhe hi'a nuwehsele'i hohstv thateyhohvhski kato takatvneli ulhskwatihsti nikehsvna kvnhitv akwatseli iyulhstohtiyi
tehikhahthaha tikhanhwtvhsti nahski lhehsti tsatayhonelvki lhehsti tsatalhvki lehsti tsanhskihsvki lhehsti kaykoki tshanhohelhvki lhehsti tsatalnuhelhvki tsatota ale tsatsi tehilvkwohtehsti
unetsvnho hi'a nuwehseli thateyhohvhski hi'a nahski nikatv takhskwankothanv tsitshutsa kehsv nvtakvwatalenvtv
uyonho uyelvnhe nahski natsiwehselv ale ehihsti kwatanhvhthi utanvhse'i utsathiyhenho unha'e'i
tsihsanho uthuwitv tukhanhanitolv hi'a nituwehsele kvwhstawatitohi nahstaya tsukvwalhoti unihi unelahvhi utselikohi wuniyvhstiy

kvwhstawatitohinho kvwhskwanikohsele nahski nuwehsvi ahsenho tsihsa thaline i'unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i titsiyolhi nahstaya nahski kenhvihsti kehsv analhskahstohtihski unelhanvhi utselikohi wuniyvhstiyi
uli ahitiyu kemili yvk kahsanenatvtiyi ukhahthvlehihstiyi anho uwenha'i yvwi unelhanvhi utselikohi wuyvhstiyi
ulohsvhsthanvhinho unihskwanikohske'i hi'a nitanatawehsehe'i kakokhe yeli kayetsihstehlhvhti
nhkwonho kwita ulenvhe hi'a nuwehsele'i khvnhiyukwo ayv nikatiyu okhvhtetsonv ale nihi itsvhstawatenv
ahsenho unitsatha nahski ikvyi tsiki onhi kehsehsti onhinho tsiki ikvyi kehsehsti

hi'a nikwehske'i khvnhiyukwo tsiluhslmi witikhahthi ale yvwi uwetsi totayetsiyohsi nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv anelhohi al tinowhelihski ttaketsiyohihseli ale totakvwukhohtaneli uyohuhihstiyi ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi witotvniyohihseli
hi'ano nituwehsele'i katonho ihsttuli ihstvytvnhehtiyi
uwehtiyihskini akwolhv tsikathihsi itilv ale tsikahskani itilv vlha ayv akwatanhehti yiki unvhsvhskini nahski kkatvnhvihstanelvhi tsiki
ahskohinho iyanitv unathvkanv unalenvhe utsathi ehsk tuniyelvnanele tsimi ale tsani

ahsenho tsihs wituyhanhv hi'a nituwehsele'i itsikahthaha nahski unikvwiyuhi ketsiyelvi kehsv tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tanewatihsvi tikvwananelhohtohtiyi nanvhnheho'i tsnilvkwotinho kehsv kvwanatalinehiteho'i
al khilo nihi nitsatvnhv nukvwiyuhsv iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski nikatv kvwanvhsitohi kehsehsti
tselikonho uniluhtse'i ale nahski tseliko i'unukotsv ale nahski kvwahstawtitohi ale unitsathi yvwi tikhewi kwatimiya nahski timiya uwetsi uwolhe nvnohulhoti atulatihske'i
unitsathenho kvwkvhskolvne kvwanetsele elhaweyi uwvhtiyi ahsenho utlikwo ika'i uwelhunhe'i tewi uwetsi skitoliki atihske'i
nahskinho uta'inv unhuwo tulenhe'i ale tsihsa wuluhtsele'i
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehseli kato tsatuli kvyatvnhehtiyi tikhewinho hi'a nuwehseli tsakvwiyuhi vakikowhahthvhtiyi akwatuliha
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehseli henakwon tsohiyuhsv tsahstelv khilakwono iyvtv kwakowhahthvhti nulhsthane'i ale uhstawatvhse tsihsa a'ihsvi
unvnhihstiyinho kehsv iyu'i unvhse unvhsitahsti tlokehsi tsunilvwihstanehi tinehvi nahski tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi nvtakvwanehtiyi unehkwotsvhi thelvlati tawhsvi
ikvwaniyvhenho ale ikvwali'vnhile'i ale ahsvha ikvwanhikihsthane'i
thalinenho nvwatale unvhse'i ale nahski unilhe'i ale unitsathe nvwanatale'i ikatv tanili'vnhihe'i ikatvnho tanihihe'i
ahsenho nahski na tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi hi'a nitunatawehsele'i hi'a nahski tsukvwalhohti wuthiyelihihsti kehsvi kha etiluka tsukvwaltinho uthiyeti ikatselika kehsehsti
kvwaniyvhvnho kvwalhe'i ale thlvlati tawhsv to'ytitlv wikvwata'invhse'i
katonho nahski tvtvneli thelvlati tawhsv utselika takaluhtsi ale tottvthani nahski tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi ale nvwanatale totvnheli thelvlati tawhsvi
nahski hi'a yhowa nutvnelv ale uhskwaniktiyu tetakhanihskvi
unanelohthanenho kvwaniyvhtiyi ahseno unitsathi yvwi tanihska'ihe'i anikahthaheyhenho unvhsv ketsitvkv nhahski tulhilohsthanvi ikvwatanvelenho ale tunenvhse'i
tuninvhsenho wikvwaluhtsehtiyi khilo iyunahsti anikwalihsi ale elotv kvwahstelihski unihsatvtiyi unatulihske kawonihskvi

uniluhtsvnho hi'a nikvwawehsele'i thateyhohvhski otsikhahthaha tyukohthv hiwonihsk kehsvi ale khilo nithnyehskvna kehsvi vlhayhenho nunahstv yvwi yithlvkwohto'i unelhanvhihskini unvnhv utohiyuhsv tehateyhohvhsko'i tuyukohtihsko ayelhi anakhuyihskv sihsa akhuyvehtiyi lhakhe
tayotsinhitsu lhakhe yvtayotsinhi ahsenho akhahthahe unatlonahstvi hi'a nituwehseli katonho ihskikoliyeha ehski'vhsi akihs tsukvwalhohti nahski akikowhahthvhtiyi
nkwale anihsatuhsi ikvwaluhtsele'i nahski ayohuhsv vlha tilehihsohti yiki anatihski ale ikvwthvtvnhe'i hi'a nuniwehse'i

thateyhohvhski mohsi okowhelanelvki hi'a nokiwehselvki analhinvtli khilo ayohuhskehsti ale utali'i ikakhhiyahskehsti tsuwetsinho nitikakhahiyhskvna ikehsehsti analhinvtli ayhanihskehsti utali'i ale nahski analhinvtli tsuwetsi tathvhihstanehehsti
nahskinho kalhihkwoki analhinvtli anehvki ikvyinho ehi utehsvnhvki ale uyohuhsvki tsuwetsi nanehvna
thalinenho wehi nahski utayhvhsvki ale uyohuhsvki nahskwonho nahski vlha tsuwetsi yituwekhhiye'i ale nahskiya nahskwo tso'ine wehi
nahiyuhyhenho tsunalhihsohti kehsv tsuniyohuhsvhi vlha yitantehsvhvhsko'i vlha ale yitiketsiyeko'i kallathskini anehi ktsinvhsithsti nunahstv nahskiya nunahsti
vlha tsuniyohuhsvhi unatseli unelhanvhi yiki tinvnhotvhskini unatseli unelhanvhi nahski iyuhsti utsathi itsilitahstiha
tinowelihskinho kehsv ahsiyvwi uluhtselv uthvkanv analhihnohehskvi ale utolehohsv ohsiyu nuwehsv tunetselvi uthvtnhe'i kato uhsti uli kalvkwtiyu nikatv tikhanhawatvhsti kehsvi utvnhe'i
ale hikeyuhsehsti yihowa tsanelhanvhi hvhtihskehsti nikhv tsanawhi ale nikhvtsatanhvhto ale nikv tsatanvhthehtiyi ale nika'v tsalhinikvkvi hi'a nahski wutakonahtvt kalkwohti tikhanhawatvhsti
tikowhelihskinho hi'a nuwehsele'i kha thateyhohvhski tuyukhohtv nhiwi sakwokwoyhenho eha unelhanvhi vlha ale nvwatale yeha nahski uwahsvhiyu
tsihsanho unhetsv tateyohvhskv uthvnvtikalawi'ihstiyi hi'a nuwehse'i katonho tinowhelihski kalonetv tewi uwetsi tsanatihsko'i
ale nukvwyuhsv tkahskilv tikalawi'ihstiyi ale nukvwiyuhsv tsunantlvtiyi tanalhstayvhvhkvi
nahski tsitanihsvnheho tsunohsulotsvhi taninelvi ale unatlonahstv kohitiyu tsanatatolihstihsko'i hi'a nhski utli ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti tikekukotanhehti kehsehsti
tsihsanho uwolhe atelvtihtiyi tsyukohti ale ukohe nanatvnehv yvwi atelv tanihvhskv atelvtihtiyi unitsathinho tsunenha'i utsathi tanihvhske'i
wtuyhanvhvnho kvwhstawtitohi hi'a ntuwehseli utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwhseha hi'a nahski uyo iyutvnhateki uwohsulotsvhi utli ika'i ahvka ehskakwo nikatv nahski atelvtihtiyi tsanihvka
nikatvyhenho utsathi unihv unotsaletv anihvka nahskihskini'unhikitv kehsv ahvka nikatv uhvi nikatv ulhstelvhtohti uhvi
olwyonho uhsahilhv uwolhvi uthvntikalawi'ihstiyi atanelv tsuyukhohti kwta ale tsimi ale tsani ale eniti unvhsv kehsv kvwathvtvnhe'i hi'a nuniwehse'i
tsihsanho tunhetshelv ulenvhe hi'a nuwehse'i itseyhahthahehsti lhehsti khilo tsitsilonuhelhi
unitsathehstiyhenho ayv takwatohstv aniluhihstihskehsti hi'a naniwehskehsti ayv nahski ale unitsathehsti tanilonuhehskehsti
itsathvkihskehstinho tanhvwa ale aninhohelhitohv tanhvwa lhehsti yitsateyhahthanehehsti nahskiyhenho ahse iyulhstohti ulhskwatihstiyihskini kehsv ahsi kehsehsti

tsunataletvyhenho yvwi totvnalenhi totvnatatluthani ale ayelhi tekolhvwatihsv totvnatatluthani ale katohi talhihthelvnhitohehsti ale takonulohsitohehsti ale uteyhahtohti nikalhsthanitohehsti hi'a nahski atalenihskv akilhiya
ohstvnho khanohetv ikvyi nikvnathv tsnewatihsv yvwi altsitohti kehsehsti
anlhinvtlinho tuyohskehsti analhinvli uyohuhihihstiyi ahskayanho uwetsi tuyohskehsti al tikekanvki tanalehvhskehsti tsunikayvlke tanatlutihskehsti ale nahski nanvnhihsihskehsti teketsi'ihehsti
ale nikatiyu yvwi ketsihskki kehsehsti ayv tskwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti khilohskini kvlhskwatihski tikhanhwateki nahski atsihstelhvhti kehsehsti
ale khilo kahsanali ukhilehsti lhehsti yvtitlo'ahskehsti atanelv wyayvhihehsti ale lhehsti nanha wiyyvhihehsti wukihstiyi kohuhsti unha'v kanelvi
ale khilo tlokehsi etohi lhehsti yti'utsvhsehsti unhuwo yunehsolhehsti
ale uyo'iyu iyunalhstanhehti tininelitv ale tsunhsta'i nahiyu kehsehsti
ale ukvwiyuhi nitukolatvna yikehse nahiyu ika vlha ukwetalhi ykayetsihstelvhe'i kkahsuyetvhskini nvtikalhstohtiha nahski tsuhsuyet kehsvi nahski tukolatv nahiyu ika
nihihskini itseyhahthahehsti khvnhiyukwo nikatv nitsvnonhelv
ale nkwhsi anikhalv kalvlo'i aninko'ahskehsti ale unitsathe klvlo tsanikhala tvnalhihthelvnhi
nhakwonho tnikohi yvwi uwetsi tsa'ihsehsti ulokilvi unhuwohstehsti utsathi ulhiniktiyu kehsv ale kalvkwtiyu kehsvi
utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehsehe hi'a nahski khohi tsaneha vlha ytvnilohsonhi khvn hi'a nahski nikatiyu nikalhsthanvha
kalvlo ale elohi tvnilohsonhi ayvhskini akhinetsv vlha yvtakalohsonhi
itseyhahthahehsti itsiyawhskehsti ale itsatatolihstihskehsti vlhaynho yitsikahthaha iyu kehsvi

thalinho wnuhsvlhv khanohiyki tilhstayvhtiyi ale nakothanvna katu akihstiyi uhskwalhvti kehse'i nunikvwihsvnho atsilvanelhi ale tinowhelihski uniyhole iyunatnhehtiy kalonhetv untohtiyi uninihytiyi ale unihihstiyi
ahsenho vlhehsti tilhstayhvhtiyi iyu ika kehsvi yanlhihthelhvkyhenho yvwi unatvnhe'i
khilonho unatahsuye unvhyutse totsuntanvhthvi ale hi'a nuniwehse'i katonho hi'a atsewoki atloneti
yunintinvhseyhenho nahski hi'a atloneti tso'itskwi anikihsi tsunkvwalhohti ulohsvhsti yitulikvwalhane'i ale uyo iyunatvnhateki tiknheti yikehse'i ale kvwhaknelohihsele'i
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehse'i unelaki katnho i'etsateyahthohtiha ohsiyu te'ulvwhstahsi tsinakwka
uyyhenho iynatvnhateki nikohilv ketshelatitoha ale iyukwo itselihskvi ohstv yinitetsatvnhihsi ayvhskini vlha nikohilv ytsvyelatitoha
unathvkanno ohsiyu uniyelvnhe'i ale unithu'ihstanele atelv tsuninhehtiyi uyholenho ohstv ulanvtatehtiyi tsuyohihsehtiyi
tahstahshelinho uthvn kalvlati khanvhsulvi kayula kvnha'i ale atvnihsthanvhi nanh skiyatvnhvihstanelvha
kvwhstawatitohinho unenvhse ale tikatuhv wuniluhtse'i ale wniwhahthe nahskiya nituwehseli unatvnhvihsthanenho khnohiyeki tilhstayvhtiyi
nahskinho anintlha'e'i ale anlhstayvhvhske'i tsihsa hi'a nuwehse'i utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwehseha ahsiyvwi hi'a tsinitsatvnhv itsulaha tsohstalhstayhvhska tvkwaluthani
unetsvnho hi'a nituwehsele'i ahsiyvwi thaltu itsitv kehsv nahski itsulaha athelitokihi tsohstahsuwhska
analhstayvhvhskvnho tsihsa katu ukihsv ale ulhelitsv ukvhaluyhe'i ale tunhele'i ale hi'a nuwehse'i itsiki itsika hi'a nahski ayv tsiyelvi
hi'anho nituwehsele'i hi'a nahski ayv akikikv its khanohetv talohihstvi nahski unitsathi tsikekatsewelv
tuninhokihsvnho uninukotse olwyo otalv wunilohse'i
kehsemininho tutv uniluhtse'i hi'anho nituwehsele kwhstawatitohi anhi itsinehsti wktatolihstihskv ikohitv
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i akwatanhvhto utsathi uteyhahthaneha ayohuhihsti nahskiya'i anhi itsinehsti ale itsiyawhskehsti
uhstikhitvnho iyvtv i'uwenv elati utanvne'i ale utatolihsthane uthayolhe'i nahski yeli ikvwalhstohti yiki nahiyu kehsv ulohihsehtiykwo
ale hi'a nuwehse'i akwa etota nihi kehsv yelikayakwo iketsatvnhehti nika'vi skihvhsikwo hi'a nahski ulihskwiti vlhahskininonv ayv akwatulihskvi nihihskini tsatulihskvi
thalinenho iyvtv wulohsv utatolihsthane'i nuwehsv nahskiya wnuwehse'i
titsalehvka itna kvnhiyukwo akwatlutihski ehskaniyu taya'i

nikohilv nkatatolihstihskv nitsithayohihv nihi nitsi'v etsitolihstiyi ulhelihsti akwatanhvthv katatolihstihskvi
nvtikalhstohtihskv itsahthehkwalohsv ohstv khanohetv tetsikhanhwatihsvi ikvyiyi ika nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi

nahski tsituyukohti nahski itsvyelihsehtiy nitsi'vi nvtikalhstohtihskv akinawiyi itsvhskwanikotvi nahskwoyhenho vkwalhvit kehsvi ale tsihstelihskv al tshihstayitihskv ohstv khanohetv nihi nitsi'v itshelatihstiha kvwakahthiya vkitolikvi
unelanvhiyhenho akwatseli akhahthahi nika'v itsvkyuhsvli tsihsa kalonetv utakeyuhti kvtihskvi
nahski itsikowhahthvhtiyi tsutalenhvtv tutalenha'vi nahski nitsatlonahstvna itsalhstohtiyi ale nitsatanhahskwalohstihskvna kalonetv utseli ika alhiylolhv kvtihski
nahski itsikhalitsvhi iyulhstohtiyi tuyukohtv kehsv utalenvhi nahski tsihsa kalonetv iywanhihsohtiyi nahski ulvkwhotohtiyi unelhanvhi ale khvnikehsv iywanehtiyi nahsk kalvkwtiyu kehsvi
ikatv utohiyuhi atvyukehti kehsv ale athsvhsti kehsv unatulihskv nvtikalhstohtiha analtsitohvhska kalonetv aninhoheha ikatvnho nahskwo ohsiyu uniyelvhsvi

hi'a nahski suntaleki kehsv analitsitohvhska kalonetv aninhoheha athsvhstikwo kehsv unatulihskv nvtikalhstohtiha vlhano nntlonahstvna kehsv yanhvhtiha uninhehkwohstiyi uniyelvha tsikiliyokv vkwalhvitv kehsvi
anihso'ihskini kkkyuhiyu kehsv nvtikalhstohtiha anikhathahayhenho vkinetselvhi kehsv akhstelhvhtiyi ohstv khanohetv

nahskiya utsathi akwatulihskv ale utuki akwvhsvi nahski nika'v kohuhsti akwatehohihstiyi nikehsvna nika'vkwohskini nitsihska'ihvna kehsvi tsinuhstokwo nahskiya nahskwo kohi kalonetv tsilvkwtohti kehsehsti tsiyelv kvhti nahskwo kvnotv kehsv ale akiyohuhihsti kehsvi
ahsiyhenho yakwalenitolv kalont tsilvkwotohti yakiyohuhsvnho ayv akinehkwotsehti
thalynho iyutaleki kehsv ahstayyu nakwalhstaneha nvtikalhstohti akwatulihskv akwanikihstiyi ale kalonetv tsehv wakwatehtiyi nahski wutkonatthv uli ohsiyu tsiki
nahskino hi'a tsinuhsti tsakwohiyuha tsikathaha akwalenitahstiyi ale nitsi'v itsvyelatitahstiyi nahski itsinehkwotsehtiyi ale itsalihelihstiyi itsohiyuhsvi
nahski utsathi unhekwotsvhstiyi itsalhelikv tsihsa kalonetv iywanihsatv ayv nvtikalhstohtihskv nahski thaline witsvlutsehti kehsv iyuhsti

nahski iyuhsti iyunho kalonetvyi ukalhsti nvtakvwataleti kehsehsti iyunho atakeyti kehsv atanhuwohihstihski kvwatanhehti kehsehsti iyunho kvthehkwalohti kehsehsti atanvhto vtathinehti kehsvi iyunho atatolihsti kehsv ale utanvhthi kehsv ehehsti
itsikhalitsa kali'elikvi ulhoyi iyulhstohtiyi itsatanvhthehskvi ulhoyikwo iyulhstohtiyi tetsatakeyuhsvi ulhoykwo iyulhstohtiyi tetsatanhvhthvi ulhoykwo iyulhstohtiyi titsatanhvhto
lhehsti kohuhsti yitsatvnehehsti athsvhsti kehsv ale ahsekwo atlkwhsti kehsv kvhti elatikwohskini nitetsvnhv tetsatanvhthv itsihsiyvwha utli ntetsilvkwohtehsti anihso'i ehskkwo itsvhsv
lhehsti khilo uwahsvkwo utseli yukhsayhstehsti nani'vhskini anihso'i nahskwo unatselika
nahski hi'a nuhstehsti tetsatanvhthehsti nahskiy nahskwo tsutanthe klonetv tsihsa
nahski tsihsa tuto'v nikatiyu tsunalhinikwanehtiyi nahskwo kalvlo'i anehi ale elohi anehi ale elohi hawintilv anehi
ale nikatiyu tikanka khvnkehsv iyunvneti kehsehsti nahski tsihsa kalonetv ukvwiyuhi kehsvi kalvkwohtiyu iywanehi kehsehsti unelhanvhi akayvlike'i
nahski iyuhsti itsvkeyu'i nikohilvkwo tsitsohiyuhvhsko'i vlha ayv tsikathhvkwo iyuhsti kohihskini kehsv akikhonelvi utli iki ttsilvwhstahsi etsihstelhvhtiyi kehsvi itsinayhskv ale tetsinawhskvi
nahski nahskwo winikalhstoht nihi itsaliheliki ale skiyalikohvhsi ayv kli'elikvi
vlhaynho khilo yokinalikoha ulhoyi utanthawateki nahski ahse kvwakhsayhstohti kehsv nitsatvnhatekvi
ahsenho etsikathha nuhstv nahski atsikoliyvi nahski khilo uwetsi utota tsahstelihsko nahskiya akhstelvhitolv ohstv khanohetv ulhiyilvhstiy takilvwhstanehvi
nahski iyuhsti uthuki akwvha nahski tsinvhstiyi ikvwnvtv katole'ohsvkwo iyakwlhstanehti kehsvi
ahsenho tsiyalihskahstotiha ukvwiyuhi ulhskolhvhtohtiyi ayv nahskwo akwhsv nikohilvna wtsvluhtsehtiyi
utsathiyhenho utulihskvki itsikowhatvhtiyi nitsi'vi ale utsahthi kaketv utanthawatekvki nvtakalhstohtihskvki itsathvkanv utlvtsvi
utohiyuhiyhenho utlvkvki ale alekwo nuyohuhsvki ahsenho unelhanvhi uwetolitsvki vlha ale nahskikwo uwahsv ayvhskini nahskwo nahski ulohsilotv uyo akwatanthatihstiyi nikehsvna
ulhskwalthinho kehsv italhinvtli itsalheliki ukvwiyuhi kehsv iyuhsti hi'a nhski witsvyowelanehtiyi utohiyuhi vlha tsuyawe'ihsti ykiyelvha ayv nihihskini unayehihsti kehsv itsutalehski
tetseyhahthotsehehsti kilhi tetseyhahthotsehehsti uyo tsunilvwhstanehi tetseyhahthotsehehsti tinihuhstehski
ayvyhenho tsekuhstehselvhi unelhanvhi atanvhto kvhti etatatolihstanehi tsiki ale italiheliki kalonetv tsihsa etalihskahstohtv iyuhsti ale ukwetalhi kehsv nikalhskahstohtvna tsiki
ahseno nika'v nahski kvkwalhstelhvhtohti akiylvnhvi nahski ehskkwo iyakwnehi akiyelvha kalonetv nvtakalhstota

ale nahski tetsiyanelhohtv vkwathvhtiyi akwatutalehstohti akwvhsv akwatseli nakihvna kehsvi nahski tikhanhawtvhsti kvwatanhehti tsiki nahskini kalonet kohihyti kehsv tsvtitalehvhska nahski atutalehstohti kehsv unelhanvhi nvtayutalenhvhi tsiki nahski kohihyti kehsv khvhtohti tsiki
nahski tsikatho'vhihstiyi ale ulhiniktiyu kehsv nahski uyohuhsv tulehihsanhvi ale akwltihstihskv nahski ukilhiyotsitolvi ale uyohuhsv nahskiya akiyohuhihstiy

vlhahskininon kayula tsitakiniyvhso nahskiya yakiyelvha vlha ale akhskwatvhi kayula yakiyelvha tsihstawatekahskini iyu yeli yki nahski tikiniyhvhtiyi nahski nahskwo ukvwalhi kalonetv tsihsa tsitakiniyvhvki
tikethv itilv tkalihskwaliha ahsahstv tikiniyvhtiyi nahski unelhanvhi kalvlati nvtayutalenhvhi atayhahntohti kehsv kalonetv tsihsa akvtihskvi
nahski iyuhsti ayv niti'v ikihskwatvhi kehsvi nahski nuhstehsti ikatanhvhthehsti ale iyu kohuhsti kehsv nvwatal nuhstehsti totsatanthehsti unelanvhi nahski hi'a nahskwo kvnikehsv nvtatsvnheli
italhinvtli itsathehkwalohi skihstawateki kehsehsti ale tetsakhsayhstehsti nahski iyanatvnehi anetohvi nahski ayv skiyatelohkwa'ehi tsitehskiyakhaha
unitsathayhenho anetoha nahski uwakhuhthilotv katsine'ihsthanvhi itsvnonhelvhi ale khohi kehsv nahskwo tikakatloyihi itsvnonheha nahski anihskaki kehsv tsutanhawatv kalontv utselika
nahski unihskwatihstohti kehsv atathvhtihski tsiki unanelhanvhi unihskwolhiyikwo tsiki ale unatehohihstihskikwo anatlvkwhstihski tsiki nahski elohikwo ehi unakhsayhsti tsiki
ayvyhenho kalvlati itehi nanha nahskwo nvtayulohihstiyi tsitikhahthenhoha ikihstelihski nahski ukvwiyuhi tsihsa klonetv

nahski tikintliyvehti tsiki nitikalvkwohtvna titiyelvi nahskiya itsuwanetiyi uwahsv kalvkwtiyu ayelv nuhstvi nahskiya ulhinikvkv khvhtihskv nikatiyu tsutalenhvtv uwahsv tikvwanelhohtohtiyi iywanhehtiyi
nahski iyuhsti italhinvtli itsvkeyu'i ale utsathi itsvyanvthi skiyalelihstihski ale akwalhstulotohti nvwhstehsti ulhinikt tetsitokehsti ukvwiyuhi etsalihskahstohtvi itsvkeyu'i

ale kvhstiyetiha nahskwo nihi nitsatlonahstvna kvkinahthkwalohi kvkhstelhvhtiyi na anikeyhv kvkhstelvhitolvhi takilvwhstanelv kalitsitonhitohv ohstv khanohetv hiyalhoyahsthanvha nahskwo tlmina ale anihso'i utlhoyi tsokilvwhstanehi nahski tunato'v tsitekowhela kvnhitv atanhehi kowhelihi
itsalihelikehsti nikohilv ukvwiyuhi nvtikalhstohtihskehsti itsalihelikehsti katiha thaline
lhehsti kohuhsti yitselihihskehsti nutalehsvhskini kohuhsti atatolihstohti ale athayohsti kehsv kvhti alihelihsti kwaltlhoyahsti khvnkehsv netsvnhehehsti unelhanvhi nuhstv itsatulihskvi

nahski ktalenhvtv skiyatelohkwa'elvhi kehsvi ale tihskiyatanilvtselvhi kehsvi ale skiyatkanelvhi kehsvi ale skiko'elvhi kehsvi nitsatvnehehsti unelhanvhinho nvwahtohiytv atanhehi titsikhanhawatitahsti kehsehsti
ahsenho ukvwiyuhi utsathi tsiyali'elitsvki nahski nhakwo uwohitsvhi skiyanvthv thaline atsehiyoki nahski nanha ukvwalhi nahskwo skiyanvthvki ahsenho vlha yitsatlanvtatehe'i
vlha atina akinhikvhsehv tsine'ihstihskv yiki akwatelhohkwa'vyhenho nika'v nakwalhstanhelitekv ohsiyukwo akiyelhvhtiyi

tsikathaha iyakwatvnhehtiyi elati yinakwatvnhateka al tsikathaha iyakwatvnhehtiyi utsathi yakiha nika'v tekehsatihsvi al nika'v nakwalhstanelitekvi vkwyhonhv iykwatvnehtiyi nahskwo yakwolhanv ale nahskwo yakiyohsiha nahskwo utsathi yakiha ale nahskwo ykhinikvhseha
nika'vkwo ikvkwatvneti kalonetv iywanhihsatv nahski tskwalhinikohihstiha
ahsehskininonv ohsiyu nitsatvnelv tsihskinelv akwalhstelhvhtohti tsikiliyokv iyu'i

nahskino nihi kwlikiyi itsehi itsikahthahehsti nahskwo nahski ohstv khanohetv ikvyiyi itsvyltsitonhelv nahiyu mahsitoni akwanhikihsv vlha ilvhitlv unatalhuhkv tsunanelhohti kohuhsti yikvkwatvnhele nahski atanhehti ale vtathinehti kehsv ukvwalhi nihi itsvhsv
tehsilonikyhenho wketohv sakwo nitsatanvhsvki akinikvhsehv akwalhstelhvhtohti ale nahskwo thaline'i
ahsenho akwanelhanvhi itsinehti kehsehsti nika'v itsinikvhsehvi nahskiya uwnha'iyu ale kalvkwotiyu kehsvi kalonetv tsihsa iywanhihsatv
nhakwonho unelhanvhi ale ikitota kalvkwohtohti kehsehsti nikohilv ale nikohilvi emenv
tetsiyolha nani'v unatanthi kalonetv tsihsa anohiyuhvhski otsalhinvtli anhi tsotsetoha wiketsiyoliha
nani'v unatanhvthi wketsiyoliha ho ukvwiyuha nahski na sihs tutathinha'vi

ayv kwola unelanvhi akinvhsitohi ale tsihsa kalonetv akinvhsitv nahskiya unohiyuhsv unelhanvhi tsuhsuyetv al nahskiya titanilvihsti kehsv tuyukohtv kehsvi nahski unelhanvhi kanayehihsti kehsv nahskiya tsiki
ahsenho nahiyu ahselhvhi kehsv kvnikehsv nuwanele utsel khanohetv uwvhthane alhitsitohti kehsvi nahski ayv vkwakhenvtvhi tsiki nahskiya unhetsv unelhanvhi ikihstelihski
hi'a nvtakalhstohtihskvki lhitiyi tsvtakvyakhhiyvki nahski ohstv itsvnelitahstiyi nahski tsutalenhvtv unhohsvnhvi ale thikhohtiyi tikekanelhohti tkatuwhatihsvi nahskiya itsatvnhehtiyi kvnetselvi
utahskwanikotohtiyihskini ohsiyu uyelvhi ohstv kehsv ukeyuhi uyhvhstehski nikehsvna tuyukohtv iyatvnehi nahskanhvna ulhsinahsti

ahstaya tsuniyvhi nutalitahstvna khanohetv nahskiya akeyonhvi nahski ntayulhstohtiyi yelikwo tikvwawonhehtohti ohstv titeyohti kehsv kvhtihskvi ale kvwantohiyunanehti ikwanhehti tinikhahthileki kehsvi
nahski tiniholi ahse tketsihstunehti nahski nani'v sitanelvhi anehi tinikthahvhski nahski tsitanateyhohvhska nituyukhohthvna tsiki tsunateyhohtiyi tsukvwalti kataha unikvhskv iyuhsti
nunakhsayhstvnakwo iyulhstohtiyi anitsuhsi unnhelhvti kehsvi ale yvwikwo nahski tuyukohtv kehsv tinikolhski uninhetsvhi

nahski na unatanvkalvtv kehsvi nikatiyu tsutalenvtv unatanvkalvelvhi kehso'i nahskihskini na kataha iyunalhsthanvhi ale nunohiyuhsvna vlha kohuhsti unatanvkalvelvhi yikehso'i nahskwohskini tunatanvhthv ale tsunukhohtohtiyi kataha itikvnelvhi
nihihskini hinohehskehsti nahski ohstv titeyhohti kehsv ulilohvhski
nahski tsunathvhsonhvhi tsuniyhstehski nikehsvna iyunalhstohtiyi ketsilvkwoti unalhsinahihsti nukolvna kehsv unohiyuhsvi ale unatakeyuhsvi ale tinvnhitiyu kehsvi

anikeyhv nahskwo anikayvlike'i nahski tunilvwhstanehv tuyukohtv iyatvnehti kehsv ulilohvhski yiki uhsonv anatanhohehski nikehsvna kikake'atithahsti unikanahsihski nikehsvna ohstv kehsv tinateyhohvhski
nahski tikvwaneyhohti yiki aniwinakehsani anikeyhv unalhsinahihsti iyulhstohtiyi tsunikeyuhi iyulhstohtiyi tikvwaniyhehi tsunikeyuhi iyulhstohtiyi tsunetsi
aniwin nahskwo thinetsehehsti unalhsinahihsti iyunalhstohtiyi
hiwonihskv ohstv yiki nahski kkhonelohihsti nikehsvna nahski na tsatlutihski kvwatehohihsti yiki nuhvnv kehsv iyuhsti kohuhsti uhsonv lhonohehtiyi
ketsinvhsitahsti tehinetsehehsti tsunohiyuhtiyi unvhs tikvwaninvhsitohi nika'vkwo nanatvnehv ohstv uniyelhvhti tsunilvwhstantiyi thalinekwo nvtninekvna
kvwakahthiyayhenho utatolihsti kehsv unelhanvhi nahski atahstelihski nani'v yvwi uninanukotselv

ikeyhvhska nahski itatayhihv unelhanvhi tinelhohtohti nikehsvna kehsvi ale elohi ehi atulvnhvti kehsvi ikalhsinahihsti ale tuyukhohtvi ale unelhanvhi kalvkwohtohti kehsv yitalenhitoha anhi elohi kehsvi
yitikhahthiya ohstv utuki kvti kehsvi nahski kalvkwotiyu nutvnhehsti kanankotsilhv kalvkwohti unelhanvhi ale ikihstelihski tsihsa kalonetv
khilo uhsonv uninohehtiyi nikehsvna tsunathiyohsathi nikehsvna iyunalhstohtiyi unatanhvhthihskini iyunalhstohtiyi khvnikehsv iyunvnehtiyi nani'vkwo anikhahthahv utsathi unatanthiyu kehsvi

ikvhsvyhenho nahskwo ilvhiyu tsikehsv ikineku kehsvki nikohiyuhsvna ikilitahsthanhvhi kohuhsti tetatvnhehvki tsutalenhvtv atulvnhvti kehsv ale ohstv atatanvtatihstihski kehsvi uyo kehsv ale atvhyukehti itehvki ikinikwathihsti ale titatankwathihi kehsvki
nahski kvwakahthiya utatolihsti kehsv tikatutalehsthanvhi kehsvi nahski nahskiya ulhskwatihsti nikehsvna kvnhitv ikatseli iyulhstohtiyi nahskiya uthuki ikvhsvi
khilo tikalenvhtihski sakwo ale thali iyakeyhahthanvhi kehsehsti etsiyo'ihselvha
iyunho athima tsinvhsvha witsluhtsehtiyi ale tikika halhinikvnelvha nakokwali skiluhtsehtiyi nanhayhenho takwkhohthanv akwkolatiyvhtiyi
ale nahskwo tikatselika wantelhohkwa nikohilv ohstv tsunilvwhstantiyi nahski utulhvhti nikalhstihskv kohuhsti kvhthanitahsti nahski aninehkwohski iyunalhstohtiyi
